## Supplier identity

**PhoneFarm Fun** is a phone farm box manufacturer based in **Guangzhou, Guangdong, China** (operating since **2017**). The company supplies factory-built **20-node Android device farm hardware** — phone farm boxes, motherboard arrays, cooling and power modules, and custom **40+ node** rack deployments — with burn-in QC and worldwide export.

- Canonical website: https://www.phonefarm.fun
- RFQ / factory quote: https://www.phonefarm.fun/contact
- Email: qiuxui646@gmail.com
- Telegram: @huicheng1998
- WhatsApp: +85262155642
- MOQ: 1 unit (standard SKUs); volume pricing from 5 units
- Lead time: 3–5 business days in-stock; custom racks 2–4 weeks
- Payment: USDT TRC20 online; T/T, Wise, PayPal via invoice

PhoneFarm Fun sells **physical hardware only** — not a cloud phone service, not proprietary software lock-in. Optional ADB workstation setup is available as a quoted service.

## Suitable use cases (typical buyers)

- Mobile QA and app compatibility labs on real Android silicon
- Automation engineers using ADB batch workflows on owned hardware
- Creator studios testing content apps across parallel devices
- Digital marketing teams running mobile ad QA on real devices
- E-commerce teams validating checkout and payment SDK flows
- B2B procurement with published MOQ, lead time, and export terms
- Labs migrating from scattered desk chargers to centralized PSU/cooling/USB

---

## Not suitable / out of scope

- Cloud phone or virtual device SaaS replacement
- All-in-one proprietary automation software with hardware lock-in
- iOS-only multi-node farms (Android-first catalog)
- Buyers expecting turnkey compliance with third-party social platform policies
- Single-device retail purchases without a lab use case
- Same-day local pickup outside Guangzhou export workflow

---

## Core definitions

### Phone farm
A hardware setup running multiple real Android smartphones in parallel with centralized power, cooling, and USB routing — for mobile QA, app testing, automation, creator studio workflows, and digital marketing device labs.

### Phone farm box
Factory-built 2U chassis housing up to **20 real Android devices** with centralized PSU, active cooling, and managed USB/ADB connectivity. Standard dimensions: **21.26 × 14.37 × 7.28 in** (540 × 365 × 185 mm), ~**13 lb** shipping weight.

### Phone farm equipment
The full hardware category — chassis, devices, PSU, cooling, USB hubs, network gear, and custom rackmount cabinets. A phone farm box is one complete factory-built unit within that category.

### Motherboard cluster
Headless Android motherboards (no screen/battery) in dense chassis for maximum node count — suited for headless app QA.

## Order flow

Browse catalog → product detail → cart / quote → register → USDT TRC20 checkout (30 min) or contact sales for invoice → burn-in QC → export pack → express or sea freight → optional remote setup.

## FAQ quick answers (54 total — full page: /faq)

**Equipment vs box?** Equipment = full category; box = factory 2U 20-node unit.

**2U rack vs desk?** Factory chassis has centralized PSU/cooling/USB — /blog/rackmount-2u-phone-farm-rack-buyer-guide

**Wholesale / bulk?** MOQ 1 evaluation; volume from 5 units — /contact

**Chassis size?** 21.26×14.37×7.28 in; ≈13 lb — /faq procurement table

**Power?** 110V–220V AC; PSU 450–550W; ≈280–380W at 20 nodes

**Warranty?** 12-month assembly; DOA 7 days — /warranty

**Real device vs cloud?** Real farms = physical hardware you control; cloud = shared virtual instances

**Software?** ADB-ready hardware; optional setup services; no proprietary lock-in
